integrity: The universal proof separates prime squares, the even squarefree case, and the odd squarefree case. The odd case reduces \((q+1)/2\mid p(p-1)\) to two exhaustive divisor branches and then solves the surviving congruence exactly. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the exact layer \(\Omega(n)=2\). It does not address \(\Omega(n)\ge3\) and makes no infinitude claim for primes \(p\) such that \(p^2-p-1\) is prime.
title: Complete two-factor classification for a divisor-sum–totient divisibility
